name: Vineyard Harvest Growth Forecast
task:
Please complete the following four-stage sequence analysis task.

A vineyard starts with 120 grapevines. Each year, the number of grapevines increases by 25% due to planting, then 8 vines are removed due to disease. Track over 6 years.

Generate the first 8 terms using the pattern.

Try to derive a closed-form expression.

Predict term 20 and verify.
